author: VANSMITHLAB
title: Pentagram
summary: A design studio in London since 1972. It operates through a partner-led model in which individual practices share one studio across graphics, environments, products, digital systems and strategy.

hero_image.alt: Proof sheets pegged along a line above a work table, carrying abstract letterform fragments and grid studies, with card models below.
hero_image.caption: Everything hung up at once: independent hands working in one room, judged side by side.
